status: EXPLORATORY. Rules were written after inspecting the outputs of this 10-case pilot. They are NOT prospectively defined evaluation criteria and must not be reported as such. They only prioritise human review; no flag is a confirmed error unless stated by kind.

incorrect_input_description.meaning: The model describes the supplied model input incorrectly. This is checkable against the logged input (e.g. 85 images supplied), so it is an incorrect description of the input, not a clinical judgement.

laterality_vs_reference_annotation.meaning: Model laterality differs from the side(s) carrying the reference infection annotation. The annotation is a COVID-19 infection annotation, not an exhaustive opacity annotation, so this is a review flag, not a confirmed model error.
laterality_vs_reference_annotation.reference_side_rule: smaller side / (left + right annotated volume) < threshold -> reference 'left' or 'right' (larger side); otherwise 'bilateral'

text_changes_with_image_processor.meaning: Raw model text differs between the baseline run and a run that differs only in the image processor implementation (same images, prompt and decoding). Only evaluable for cases present in both runs.
text_changes_with_image_processor.comparison: stripped raw text, exact string inequality

fields_change_with_image_processor.meaning: Structured fields (assessability, opacity_presence, distribution) differ between the two image-processor runs.
